evals.prompt: I'm a solo developer interested in the LLM evaluation tooling space. Find me non-obvious product opportunities I could realistically build alone. Use quick mode.
evals.expected_output: A run directory with sourced observation records, candidate JSON files that pass the lint, and a report.md containing at most 3 survivor dossiers (or an honest zero-survivor report), each with mechanism steps, closest prior art, edge status, and a falsification experiment.
expectations: A run directory was created containing observations/, candidates/, portfolio/ subdirectories and a report.md
At least 6 observation records exist, each with at least one source URL
Cited observations span at least 2 different lenses (visible in OBS- id prefixes)
Every non-graveyard candidate JSON passes scripts/lint_candidate.py with 0 errors
The report contains at most 3 survivor dossiers
Every survivor dossier cites observation ids inline
Each survivor lists closest prior art with a specific difference per item, or declares no-close-prior-art-found with at least 4 searched query families listed
The report contains none of: 'no competitors', 'first-ever', 'globally unique', 'unprecedented', 'first-of-its-kind'
Each survivor has a falsification experiment with a pre-committed kill condition

evals.prompt: are there any untapped niches around home energy monitoring? i can build hardware-adjacent software but nothing capital heavy. quick mode please
evals.expected_output: Same structural output as eval 1 in an unfamiliar consumer-adjacent domain: evidence-first run, linted candidates, honest portfolio of at most 3 with the capital constraint respected.
expectations: A run directory was created containing observations/, candidates/, portfolio/ subdirectories and a report.md
Observation records cite primary sources (forums, changelogs, pricing pages, repos) rather than only news articles
Every non-graveyard candidate JSON passes scripts/lint_candidate.py with 0 errors
No survivor requires capital-heavy hardware manufacturing (the user's stated constraint)
The report contains at most 3 survivor dossiers
Each survivor names the current workaround it replaces
Each survivor has an evidenced why-now with observation citations
Novelty verdicts come only from the controlled vocabulary: duplicated, crowded, differentiated, no-close-prior-art-found, unverified

evals.prompt: Give me 10 AI SaaS startup ideas I can launch fast.
evals.expected_output: The skill must not return 10 generic ideas. It either clarifies the brief and runs the evidence-first pipeline (quick mode), or explains the pipeline and asks for a domain constraint. Any ideas ultimately presented number at most 3 and carry evidence, mechanisms, and prior-art verdicts.
expectations: The response does not contain a list of 10 ideas
No idea is presented without cited observations behind it
No presented idea matches a generic shape (AI-powered X, copilot for X, all-in-one platform, marketplace for X) without a concrete 2-4 step mechanism
At most 3 ideas are presented in the final output
The response either asks the user to narrow a domain or picks a domain explicitly and states the choice
If the pipeline ran, every presented idea's candidate JSON passes scripts/lint_candidate.py with 0 errors
